headline:
Quality grower,
priced for it
chart_note: 52-week range: $293.89 - $385.57. Currently around $374.80, near the top of that range on strong, steady growth.
why_today: Trading near 52-week highs on the back of 14% revenue growth - a premium price for a payments network that keeps compounding.
pro_1: Revenue growth of 14.4% YoY with a Strong Buy consensus (36 Buy, 3 Hold, 0 Sell) and a beta of just 0.74
pro_2: Analysts see roughly 5-10% further upside to their average price target even after the recent run-up
con_1: PE of 32.2x and PEG near 1.8x mean the quality is already well recognized and priced in
con_2: Trading close to its 52-week high leaves less room for error if growth decelerates
